name: missions
title: Missions of flying units (one row per mission)
description: Missions of air units, one row per unit mission (not per aircraft or pilot), in data/missions/<nationality folder>/<unit_id>.csv; built into build/other_domains/missions.csv. A mission is not a location claim: it never feeds the claims, the command relations or the who_controls grid. The unit's position on the day is its base claim. Scott approved the layout on 17 November 2026 (decision J1, Normandy chunk 5).

fields.name: mission_id
fields.description: Stable id of the mission row: MSN followed by four or more digits (MSN0001), assigned in order and never reused or renumbered. A removed row goes to data/retired_missions.csv and its id is never a mission again (scripts/check_mission_ids.py checks the history).

fields.name: mission_status
fields.description: preferred, or alternate for a competing reading of the same mission in a conflict group (vocabulary mission_status; as claim_status, without disputed).

fields.name: conflict_group_id
fields.description: G### of the conflict group when two rows are competing readings of one mission (the shared G numbering of the claims: a G id is either a claim group or a mission group, never both). Required for an alternate row.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: The flying unit as the source records the mission: usually the group, a squadron when the source gives a squadron mission. A row of data/units.csv with domain air; it must equal the file name.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the mission, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the source gives only the month. Not before 1939-09-01.

fields.name: takeoff_time
fields.description: Take-off time HH:MM (24-hour, local time as the source gives it) when the source states it; blank otherwise.

fields.name: target_time
fields.description: Time over target HH:MM when the source states it; blank otherwise.

fields.name: source_mission_number
fields.description: The unit's own mission number as the source prints it (158 for the 387th Bombardment Group's Mission 158). Blank when the source numbers none.

fields.name: mission_type
fields.description: What the mission was (vocabulary mission_type). One value: a combined mission takes the first type the source states and the others go in notes.

fields.name: target_text
fields.description: The target or area as the source writes it, spelling kept (a doubtful reading of the source is kept with its question mark). Required.

fields.name: target_category
fields.description: Kind of target (vocabulary mission_target_category) when the source states it; blank otherwise.

fields.name: target_place_id
fields.description: PL#### of the target or area (data/places.csv) when the source names a place that can be located; blank when it names none (never guessed). A target place follows the normal place rules; a sea target uses kind sea_position.

fields.name: aircraft_type_id
fields.description: AT### of the aircraft flown (data/aircraft_types.csv); the family row when the source gives no variant. Blank when not given.

fields.name: aircraft_dispatched
fields.description: Number of aircraft that took off or were dispatched, as the source gives it (an integer). Blank when not given; never estimated.

fields.name: aircraft_effective
fields.description: Number of aircraft that attacked the target (credited sorties), as the source gives it. Blank when not given; never more than aircraft_dispatched.

fields.name: aircraft_lost
fields.description: Number of aircraft lost on the mission (shot down, crashed or written off), as the source gives it. Blank when not given; never more than aircraft_dispatched. 0 only when the source says none was lost.

fields.name: supported_unit_ids
fields.description: Ground (or naval) units that the source says the mission supported, as unit_ids of data/units.csv separated by "; ". Blank when the source names none; never inferred from the area.

fields.name: attacked_unit_ids
fields.description: Enemy units that the source names as attacked, as unit_ids separated by "; ". Blank when the source names none; never inferred from the area.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.description: OP-... of the operation the mission belongs to (data/operations.csv) when a source ties it to one; blank otherwise. A date outside the operation is a warning.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: How well the mission row is documented (vocabulary confidence, read for a mission: 0.9 two independent source families agree; 0.7 one authoritative or primary source such as the unit's own official history; 0.5 one secondary source such as a unit association compilation; 0.3 the date is approximate). No position cap applies, except that a target at a sea_position place keeps the 0.5 cap.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Readable citation: the source URL(s) separated by " | ", with page or section when known. Every URL must be the url of a reference listed in reference_ids.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: The stored mission -> reference links: reference ids of data/references_meta.csv separated by ";", at least one.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Page or section per reference, "R###: p. 7; R###: section ..." (blank when the source has no pages).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free text. Sentence-initial labels use the note_label vocabulary (Review:, Context:, Event definition: ...). A changed value carries old value, new value and reason, as for claims. A conflict group needs a sentence that says what differs.
